title: a root plugin.json alongside .codex-plugin/plugin.json
rationale: Codex 0.149.0 routed any directory with a root plugin.json through the Agent Plugins loader, which has no hook support, so every hook declared in .codex-plugin/plugin.json stopped running silently. The portable manifest governs the portable components. It says nothing about client-specific files, and a client must not let its presence disable its own features. Both skills must load either way.
quote: No other file can replace, supplement, or override the core fields in root `plugin.json`.
